summary: Builds full texture file paths for the 9 pit-crew/vehicle texture types (car body, driver, arms, wing, helmet, pit body, pit helmet, lollipop, refueler) by combining a base directory from this+0, team and track config strings at this+972/this+984, and a track-name-matched linked-list node, then resolves each path with TextureAdjuster. For texture index 0 it may re-derive the selected path from the matched candidate. Frees the temporary buffers and the lookup handle it allocates before returning. Called by ZeroInitWrapper (0x004DDF70) and sub_4E2A60 (0x004E2A60).

Walk the linked list starting at this+980; sub_588410 compares each node's string (fallback byte_5EA438) against the TrackName buffer. On the first match capture the node's +8 string into v42 (fallback byte_5EA438), then stop.

For each of the 9 texture-type indices 0..8, dispatch through jump table jpt_4DDC40 (0x004DDF4C) and select the wc-prefixed variant string and the regular variant string: index 0 aWccarbody with default string, index 1 aWcdriver/aDriver, index 2 aWcarms/aArms_0, index 3 aWcwing/aWing, index 4 aWchelmet/aHelmet_0, index 5 aWcpitbody/aPitbody, index 6 aWcpithelmet/aPithelmet, index 7 aWclollipop/aLollipop_0, index 8 aWcrefueler/aRefueler.

Assemble up to three candidate name components: the a2 name argument (v48) and the track-name-matched node string (v42) always when non-empty; for texture indices 5-8 also the this+984 config string; always, room permitting, the this+972 config string. Each skipped component falls back to byte_5EA438.

For each selected candidate path: copy the base directory with StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, strip its trailing backslash, append the candidate component via sub_5665B0, truncate at the last '.' to drop any extension, then append the file name found by sub_589DB0(v22, 46) or the '.bmp' extension string aBmp (0x005D4C0C) when none is found.

When fewer than three candidates were selected, fill the remaining v50 slots with the current wc-variant string plus the '.bmp' extension aBmp (0x005D4C0C) via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and sub_5665B0.
Resolve the final texture path for the current variant with TextureAdjuster(variant, 1, firstCandidate, configStrings, ..., a4); the returned selector v31 is used for index 0 only.

For texture index 0 when argument a3 is set: if the TextureAdjuster selector is 3 or more, reset the path to the default byte_5EA438 string; otherwise copy the selected candidate's path truncated at the last backslash (character 92), via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
After the 9-iteration loop completes, release the lookup handle v46 with PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval when it is non-zero.
